Only one merged PR since 2026-04-11 added or removed a `configUrls` line under `packages/tooling/openmrs`: **PR #1905**, "(docs) Rewrite the openmrs CLI README around how it's used", commit `b439966` by Dennis Kigen. Its commit date is 2026-10-02 (18:01:58 +03:00). I'm using the commit date as the merge date because the listing doesn't expose a separate merge timestamp.

The diff adds `configUrls` lines to `packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md`: the example build config, the `--config-url` row in the `develop` options table, and a note on `${openmrsSpaBase}` in `configUrls`. The old README had no `configUrls` lines, so the commit only adds them. These lines are still present at the pinned head `7a172083` (main).
